faqs.question: How much does your service cost?
faqs.answer: Our automation packages start at $499/month for starter funnels and $1,499/month for full multi-channel setups. We also offer custom enterprise builds.

faqs.question: Do you offer a free trial?
question_variants: Is there a demo or trial?
Do you have a free tier?
faqs.answer: Yes! You can test our interactive demo simulator right now with zero signup. We also offer a 14-day risk-free pilot.

faqs.question: How long does setup take?
question_variants: How fast can this be deployed?
faqs.answer: Most funnels are fully configured and deployed within 48 to 72 hours of our initial strategy call.

faqs.question: What platforms do you support?
faqs.answer: We support Instagram comments & DMs, Telegram bots, and custom web chat. WhatsApp support is coming soon.

faqs.question: Does this integrate with my CRM?
question_variants: Do you connect to Notion or Airtable?
Can you send leads to webhook or Zapier?
faqs.answer: Yes! Leads can be dispatched in real-time via Webhook to HubSpot, Zapier, Make, Notion, Airtable, or Google Sheets.

faqs.question: What is your refund policy?
question_variants: What if I want to cancel?
faqs.answer: We offer a 30-day money-back guarantee if our automated funnel does not generate qualified leads for your business.

faqs.question: Can I talk to a real person?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! Type 'human' at any point in this chat and our team will be notified immediately to take over.

faqs.question: Can I customize the qualification questions?
question_variants: Can I edit the funnel steps?
Can I change the lead scoring?
faqs.answer: Yes, every step, question, scoring weight, and tier threshold is fully configurable in the FunnelBot admin dashboard.

faqs.question: Will my Instagram account get shadowbanned?
faqs.answer: Our system complies with official Meta API rate limits and human-paced delivery with randomized reply templates to prevent spam flags.

faqs.question: Where is your company located?
question_variants: What country are you based in?
faqs.answer: We are a remote-first team based across San Francisco and London, serving creators and brands worldwide.

faqs.question: What languages does the bot support?
question_variants: Can it speak Spanish or French?
Does it work in other languages?
faqs.answer: Currently the rule engine and FAQ TF-IDF matcher operate in English, but custom language keyword rules can be defined.

faqs.question: Do you have an agency or white-label plan?
question_variants: Can I resell this to clients?
faqs.answer: Yes! Our Agency Plan allows unlimited client workspaces, custom domains, and white-labeled admin dashboards.

faqs.question: Is FunnelBot GDPR compliant?
question_variants: How do you handle personal data?
faqs.answer: Yes. We respect immediate 'STOP' opt-outs, store minimal PII, and provide single-click data export and deletion.

faqs.question: What analytics and metrics do you track?
question_variants: Do you have a reporting dashboard?
faqs.answer: The dashboard tracks comment-to-DM conversion rate, step-by-step funnel drop-off, lead tier breakdown, and total revenue pipeline.

faqs.question: What are your business support hours?
faqs.answer: Our automated bot runs 24/7/365. Human support agents are available Monday to Friday from 9 AM to 6 PM EST.
